```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(randomForest)

set.seed(42)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load Data & Prepare Features
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
accidents_data <- read_csv(
  "US_Accidents_March23_sampled_500k.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 100000) %>%
  mutate(
    # Response Variable
    Severity_binary = factor(
      if_else(Severity %in% c(3, 4), "High", "Low"),
      levels = c("Low", "High")
    ),
    
    # Time Features
    Start_Time = parse_date_time(
      Start_Time,
      orders = c("ymd HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd"),
      tz = "UTC"
    ),
    Hour = hour(Start_Time),
    Day_of_Week = wday(Start_Time, label = TRUE),
    
    # Predictors
    Temperature = `Temperature(F)`,
    Humidity = `Humidity(%)`,
    Visibility = `Visibility(mi)`,
    Precipitation = coalesce(`Precipitation(in)`, 0),
    Distance = `Distance(mi)`,
    
    # Categoricals
    State = fct_lump_n(factor(State), n = 15),
    Junction = factor(Junction),
    Traffic_Signal = factor(Traffic_Signal),
    Stop = factor(Stop),
    Crossing = factor(Crossing)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Severity_binary, Hour, Day_of_Week, State, Distance,
    Temperature, Humidity, Visibility, Precipitation,
    Junction, Traffic_Signal, Stop, Crossing
  ) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(
    Hour_sin = sin(2 * pi * Hour / 24),
    Hour_cos = cos(2 * pi * Hour / 24),
    .row_id = row_number()
  ) %>%
  select(-Hour)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Stratified Train / Test Split
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
logistic_train_ids <- accidents_data %>%
  group_by(Severity_binary) %>%
  slice_sample(prop = 0.80) %>%
  pull(.row_id)

train_raw <- accidents_data %>% filter(.row_id %in% logistic_train_ids) %>% select(-.row_id)
test_data  <- accidents_data %>% filter(!.row_id %in% logistic_train_ids) %>% select(-.row_id)

# Downsample training set for class balance
high_cases <- train_raw %>% filter(Severity_binary == "High")
low_cases  <- train_raw %>% filter(Severity_binary == "Low") %>% slice_sample(n = nrow(high_cases))
train_balanced <- bind_rows(high_cases, low_cases) %>% sample_frac(1)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Fit Random Forest Model
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
fit_rf <- randomForest(
  formula = Severity_binary ~ .,
  data = train_balanced,
  ntree = 300,
  importance = TRUE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Generate Predictions for Train & Test Sets
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
train_preds <- train_balanced %>%
  mutate(
    prob_High = predict(
      fit_rf,
      newdata = train_balanced,
      type = "prob"
    )[, "High"],
    pred_class = factor(if_else(prob_High >= 0.50, "High", "Low"), levels = c("Low", "High")),
    Dataset = "Train"
  )

test_preds <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    prob_High = predict(
      fit_rf,
      newdata = test_data,
      type = "prob"
    )[, "High"],
    pred_class = factor(if_else(prob_High >= 0.50, "High", "Low"), levels = c("Low", "High")),
    Dataset = "Test"
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Summary Tables: Actual vs. Predicted (Confusion Matrices)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("=====================================================\n")
cat("       CONFUSION MATRIX - TRAINING DATA              \n")
cat("=====================================================\n")
table(Actual = train_preds$Severity_binary, Predicted = train_preds$pred_class) %>% print()

cat("\n=====================================================\n")
cat("       CONFUSION MATRIX - TEST DATA                  \n")
cat("=====================================================\n")
table(Actual = test_preds$Severity_binary, Predicted = test_preds$pred_class) %>% print()

# Combine evaluation metrics table
calc_metrics <- function(df, dataset_name) {
  tp <- sum(df$pred_class == "High" & df$Severity_binary == "High")
  tn <- sum(df$pred_class == "Low" & df$Severity_binary == "Low")
  fp <- sum(df$pred_class == "High" & df$Severity_binary == "Low")
  fn <- sum(df$pred_class == "Low" & df$Severity_binary == "High")
  
  # AUC via Mann-Whitney Rank
  n_pos <- sum(df$Severity_binary == "High")
  n_neg <- sum(df$Severity_binary == "Low")
  ranks <- rank(df$prob_High, ties.method = "average")
  auc_val <- (sum(ranks[df$Severity_binary == "High"]) - n_pos * (n_pos + 1) / 2) / (n_pos * n_neg)
  
  tibble(
    Dataset = dataset_name,
    Accuracy = round(mean(df$pred_class == df$Severity_binary), 4),
    Sensitivity = round(tp / (tp + fn), 4),
    Specificity = round(tn / (tn + fp), 4),
    ROC_AUC = round(auc_val, 4)
  )
}

summary_table <- bind_rows(
  calc_metrics(train_preds, "Train"),
  calc_metrics(test_preds, "Test")
)

cat("\n=====================================================\n")
cat("         MODEL PERFORMANCE COMPARISON SUMMARY        \n")
cat("=====================================================\n")
print(summary_table)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Plot ROC / AUC Curves for Train and Test Sets
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_roc_data <- function(df, dataset_name) {
  n_pos <- sum(df$Severity_binary == "High")
  n_neg <- sum(df$Severity_binary == "Low")
  
  df %>%
    arrange(desc(prob_High)) %>%
    mutate(
      tpr = cumsum(Severity_binary == "High") / n_pos,
      fpr = cumsum(Severity_binary == "Low") / n_neg,
      Dataset = dataset_name
    ) %>%
    select(fpr, tpr, Dataset) %>%
    bind_rows(tibble(fpr = 0, tpr = 0, Dataset = dataset_name), .)
}

roc_curve_combined <- bind_rows(
  get_roc_data(train_preds, "Train"),
  get_roc_data(test_preds, "Test")
)

train_auc_label <- summary_table$ROC_AUC[summary_table$Dataset == "Train"]
test_auc_label  <- summary_table$ROC_AUC[summary_table$Dataset == "Test"]

ggplot(roc_curve_combined, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr, color = Dataset)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Train" = "#d95f02", "Test" = "#2b5c8f")) +
  coord_equal() +
  annotate(
    "text", x = 0.65, y = 0.22,
    label = paste0("Train AUC = ", train_auc_label, "\nTest AUC = ", test_auc_label),
    size = 4.5, hjust = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Random Forest ROC Curves (Train vs. Test)",
    subtitle = "Comparing performance on training vs. holdout test set",
    x = "False Positive Rate (1 - Specificity)",
    y = "True Positive Rate (Sensitivity)",
    color = "Dataset Split"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

```
